text: The Toronto Parking Authority parking lot known as 405 Sherbourne Street, is a City-owned property and one of six sites approved by City Council in May 2020 for inclusion in Phase Two of the Housing Now Initiative. This report recommends approval of a City-initiated Zoning By-law Amendment to permit a 26-storey mixed-use building with 267 rental dwelling units, of which between 33% - 50% of new units will be provided as affordable housing, and at least 168 square metres of community facility space for a not-for-profit institution will be provided. The proposal includes an enhanced public realm through a landscaped mid-block pedestrian connection between Sherbourne Street and Bleecker Street.
